Websites

When a site has no direct connection, your agent can use the site itself.

It reads the page, it clicks, it types, in a browser window on your own computer that you can watch. You sign in yourself, once, in that window. It is off until you turn it on.

Buying

Watch your agent at a checkout.

Off until you switch it on. You pick the shops and the limits, and every order still waits for your tap. It never types a card number. It goes by the price on the page, so for a hard ceiling, use a card from your bank that only works at that shop.

Stops

Where your agent hands the window back.

Today

Three add-ons use websites today.

Statement Collector

Downloads each month’s statements and bills, and files them.

Form Filler

Fills in long forms you have filled in before, and stops at Submit.

Flight Check-In

Checks you in when check-in opens and sends the boarding pass.

Or ask your agent for something on a site yourself.

Tell us which site you would hand over first.

Join the Waitlist

Already running Archie? Open an agent’s Connections tab, find Websites, and switch on Let this agent use websites itself. Then add a site under Sites it can sign in to, and press Sign in beside it.
